objective: Frozen computation: exact infinite-plane correlations on the weave (honeycomb dimer kernel) and chain grids l = 1, 2, 3 (Kac-Ward resolvent), read as count outlines; and a census of every base reachable from the line of three by admitted extensions with up to three betweenness knots, asking whether the distinction-side ball profile, with or without N, and the state-side profile determine the number of orders k and the lattice dimension.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 14 of 20 predictions held): weave 11 of 11 (the start class's count ball is round: off-row amplitudes within 8e-5 of the row's at r ~ 60; a = 0.6322260; eta = 1/2; other classes -a/2; ball 0.193 u^-4; outline ~ ball^0.58); chain grid l = 1 rates equal the closed form within 5e-5 and its anisotropy 1.003399 (C1c, C4 held; C1, C1b failed on the l = 2 axis, pre-asymptotic; C4b failed, effective exponent 2.5; C4c failed, gauge sign omitted in the scan); census: the unnamed growth profile determines k and lam to n = 12 (cheapest) and n = 6 (one split per step) but not at n = 7 (3 groups) or 8 (227), so G1 and G3 failed; the state profile fails at n = 4 (G2 held).
title: Exact outlines and the orders census
